notes: Pages name two intakes (start February and September) but give no application deadline with a day/month/year for February (only '1 februari') and only the September deadline 1 mei 2027 carries a year; no intake fact is output. Tuition: no programme-level fee for non-EU students is stated; only institution-wide instellingscollegegeld rules appear, so no tuition fact is given. The programme page is Dutch-taught; the English-taught variant is a different programme (Industrial Engineering and Management). The '21+ toelatingsonderzoek' page concerns applicants without havo/vwo/mbo-4 and is not specific to this programme.

note.en: Check the specific admission requirements for foreign diploma holders: see the 'Toelating' (international admission) page, as the programme page only mentions havo/vwo/mbo level 4.
